measures.title: City of Liberty Proposition A
measures.summary: Asks City of Liberty voters to terminate the Liberty Community Development Corporation and abolish its existing one-half of one percent (0.5%) sales and use tax for the promotion and development of new and expanded business enterprises. In its place, the city would adopt a local sales and use tax at a rate of one and one-half percent (1.5%). The ballot states this would result in no change to the total sales tax rate.
measures.yesMeans: The Liberty Community Development Corporation and its 0.5% sales tax would end, and the city's own local sales tax would be set at 1.5%, with no change to the total sales tax rate.
measures.noMeans: The Liberty Community Development Corporation and its 0.5% sales tax for business development would continue, and the city's local sales tax rate would not change.
